result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection that lacks basic pedestrian safety infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and curb ramps. While sidewalks are present, the wide, unmarked roadway and potential sightline obstructions from trees and parked vehicles create a less-than-ideal environment for walking.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks marked crosswalks, providing no designated or protected space for pedestrians to cross the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Center intersection area

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: There are no visible curb ramps at the corners, creating significant barriers for people with mobility aids or strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner of the sidewalk on the right foreground

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A large tree and parked vehicles near the intersection may obscure pedestrians from the view of oncoming drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the intersection near the large tree and parked truck

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: ADA-Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at all crossing points to ensure accessibility for all users.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the intersection corners to improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.

result.summary: A residential street intersection that lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and curb ramps. The wide, unmarked roadway and presence of parked vehicles near the corner create potential visibility and safety issues for people crossing.

hazards.name: Missing curb ramps

interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.description: Install tactile, sloped curb ramps at all corners of the intersection to ensure accessibility.
